courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 相位式計算全像
related.transfer: 可遷移「光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算」與「相機式視點映射校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；相位式計算全像的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget" and "Camera-based view-mapping calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Phase-only computer-generated holography must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦角取樣、空間頻寬積、透鏡與光柵對位、相機式視點映射、串擾與眼動延遲預算；相位式計算全像則以傅立葉全像的取樣、Gerchberg–Saxton 迭代、相位量化、相機閉環校正與全像顯示的工程化為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on angular sampling, space–bandwidth product, lens and grating registration, camera-based view mapping, crosstalk and eye-tracking latency budgets; Phase-only computer-generated holography centres on sampling of Fourier holograms, Gerchberg–Saxton iteration, phase quantization, camera-in-the-loop calibration and engineering of holographic displays, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「視角錐與角取樣」與「SLM 平面與傅立葉重建面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到相位式計算全像，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「散斑、零階與波長的誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “View cone and angular sampling” and “SLM plane and Fourier replay plane”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Phase-only computer-generated holography, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Speckle, zeroth-order and wavelength error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.scopeEn: Lists LCOS phase modulators with 3.74 to 8 µm pitch and 1920×1080 to 4160×2464 resolution, plus per-model phase strokes at different wavelengths (for example 2π across 420–650 nm, 2.5π at 800 nm); a public specification page.

references.title: Meadowlark Optics：1920×1200 空間光調制器規格頁
references.titleEn: Meadowlark Optics: 1920 x 1200 spatial light modulator
references.scope: 提供 8 µm 像素、95.6% 填充因子、各波長液晶響應時間（532 nm ≤ 15 ms、1550 nm ≤ 55 ms）、零階反射率、校正後波前（532 nm 為 λ/7）與區域式電壓對相位校正等公開數值。
references.scopeEn: Gives public numbers for 8 µm pixels, 95.6% fill factor, LC response times by wavelength (≤ 15 ms at 532 nm, ≤ 55 ms at 1550 nm), zeroth-order reflectance, calibrated wavefront (λ/7 at 532 nm) and regional voltage-to-phase calibration.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 多視角全像顯示校正
history.text: 1908 年 Gabriel Lippmann 提出整合攝影，以微透鏡陣列記錄並重現多方向光線；20 世紀初 Frederic Ives 的視差屏障與後來的柱狀透鏡把多視角影像做成平面印刷品。1989 年起 MIT 媒體實驗室 Stephen Benton 團隊以聲光調制器打造 Mark I 等全像視訊系統，首次正面遭遇空間頻寬積的瓶頸。2010 年代末起，斜向柱狀透鏡光場顯示器、以高速視覺感測器追蹤雙眼的空間實境顯示器與繞射式多視角背光陸續商品化，逐台的相機式視點映射校正成為量產必要工序。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1908 Gabriel Lippmann proposed integral photography, recording and replaying rays in many directions with a microlens array; early in the twentieth century Frederic Ives's parallax barrier and later lenticular sheets turned multiview images into flat prints. From 1989 Stephen Benton's group at the MIT Media Lab built holographic video systems such as Mark I using acousto-optic modulators and met the space–bandwidth bottleneck head-on. From the late 2010s slanted-lenticular light-field displays, spatial-reality displays that track both eyes with high-speed vision sensors and diffractive multiview backlights reached the market, making unit-by-unit camera-based view-mapping calibration a necessary production step. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算」到「系統驗收與校正交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget" through "System acceptance and calibration handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
